# A session handle NodeHandlesSpec (Scala) mints from fixed inputs, and the prelude statement that
# carries it (NodeHandles.prelude); handle_test.cpp verifies the handle and reads it back out of the
# prelude (qod::PreludeHandle), so the two sides agree on both byte for byte. `context` is the
# canonical session context NodeHandlesSpec builds (DecideContext.json) and `ctx` its SHA-256, the
# handle's ctx; `credentials` is the canonical [id, updatedAt] array of the user's S3 credentials
# (UserS3Credentials.digestJson) and `creds` its SHA-256, the handle's creds. qod-node only compares
# ctx and creds. Regenerate both sides together if either format changes.
